projectState.summary: Byte L0a is implemented on codex/byte-l0a-grow-language from base origin/main 7b22d37. It adds a pure Grow language helper module for the requested four-mode evocative bridge, degree-color helpers, inert CSS tokens --degree-1..--degree-7, and pure tests. MODE_INTERVALS is exported without changing its contents so the bridge can use the existing interval table. Noted design mismatch: main already includes lydian/phrygian in MODE_INTERVALS and SONG_GOAL_MODES, but L0a intentionally leaves them undefined for the future missing-mode byte.
